props.name: columns
props.meaning: Columns in display order, from `resolveColumns`. Two-way: hiding one writes the shorter list back.

props.name: statuses
props.meaning: Status rows by code, for status cells.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Cells render with its preferences, a cell editor reads through it, and an entity cell links to the row's page when it carries a site.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: The project the columns were resolved with. Scopes a status, list or entity cell editor.

props.name: precision
props.meaning: Decimals a float cell keeps.

props.name: symbol
props.meaning: Shown before the value in a currency cell.

props.name: density
props.meaning: Compact halves the vertical cell padding and draws a cell chip and badge a step smaller.

props.name: selectable
props.meaning: Draws a checkbox column.

props.name: group_by
props.meaning: Collapses rows under headers of a shared value at this path.

props.name: collapsed
props.meaning: Which group headers are shut, two-way. A bare id list is the open mode with those ids shut.

props.name: editable
props.meaning: Lets an editable cell open an editor.

props.name: editor_for
props.meaning: The editor a cell opens, by data type. A type it does not answer for opens FieldEditor.

props.name: editor_placement
props.meaning: Where every cell editor opens. A column's own `editorPlacement` wins over it.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Show the programmatic field path beside the header's display name.

props.name: column_menu
props.meaning: A menu on every header: sort, hide and pin left.

props.name: page_sizes
props.meaning: Rows per page offered in the footer. `pages` only.

props.name: max_height
props.meaning: Height of the scrolling body.

props.name: virtualize_after
props.meaning: Rows above which the body is virtualised.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when the read returned nothing.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Row text and header height: `text-xs`/`h-9`, `text-sm`/`h-10`, `text-base`/`h-11`.

props.name: source
props.meaning: The rows, the filter, the sort and the page behind them.

props.name: paging
props.meaning: How the set is walked: a page number, a load-more row, or the scroller.

props.name: sort
props.meaning: The source's sort, two-way.

props.name: filters
props.meaning: The source's filter, two-way.

props.name: selection
props.meaning: The selected rows, two-way. Names loaded rows only.

props.name: get_row_id
props.meaning: How a row is keyed, in the DOM and in the selection. Default `Type:id`.

props.name: is_row_disabled
props.meaning: True for a row that cannot be selected or edited.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

events.name: columns_changed
events.when: A column was hidden from its header menu.

events.name: collapsed_changed
events.when: A group header was opened or shut.

events.name: sort_changed
events.when: The source's sort changed, from a header or from the prop.

slots.name: toolbarStart
slots.draws: Left region of the toolbar above the table.

slots.name: toolbarEnd
slots.draws: Right region of the toolbar above the table.

slots.name: row
slots.receives: `{ row, id, index, selected, disabled, columns }`
slots.draws: Draws the cells of one row. The table keeps the row's box.

slots.name: cell
slots.draws: Draws one cell's contents. Ignored where `row` is given.

slots.name: groupHeader
slots.draws: Draws a group header's contents, after its chevron.

slots.name: editorFor
slots.draws: The component a cell opens for that data type.

keyboard.does: Moves through toolbar, header buttons, column menus, checkboxes, editable cells and the footer.
Sorts by that column, ascending, then descending, then unsorted.

keyboard.key: Enter, Space on a column menu
keyboard.does: Opens it; arrows walk it, Escape closes it.
Commits the value. In a textarea it adds a line, and Cmd or Ctrl with Enter commits.

keyboard.key: Enter, Escape, Save, Cancel in a popover editor
keyboard.does: The same: Enter and Save commit, Escape and Cancel restore.
Toggles the row, or every loaded row from the header.
Moves the cursor down or up the same column, over the rows it can land on.

keyboard.key: ArrowDown on the last loaded row
keyboard.does: In `more` and `scroll`, asks for the next page. The cursor stays where it is until the rows arrive, then lands on the first of them.
